title: Crispy Argentinian Fritters
description: Tasty, crispy fritters made with a blend of Argentinian spices and served with a side of velvety flaxseed sauce.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together fritters mix, egg, and olive oil.
Heat a non-stick pan with a small amount of oil over medium heat.
Using a spoon, drop small amounts of the fritters mix into the pan, flattening slightly.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the edges start to crisp.
Flip the fritters and cook for another 2 minutes or until crispy.
Serve with velvety flaxseed sauce (see below for recipe).
To make the velvety flaxseed sauce, mix together flaxseed and 1/2 cup of water in a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy, adding more water if needed.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
